basic_info.description: Gorgeous & Exceptional! This spectacular two-level Windsor Terrace home, located in the sought-after Inner Sunset district, features 3 bedrooms and 1.25 bathrooms, spanning 1914 sq. ft. It showcases beautiful architecture with an elegant and inviting floor plan, newly refinished hardwood floor, bathed in natural light throughout. Enjoy a vintage kitchen with a separate breakfast room, and living and dining rooms with built-in cabinets and shelves. All three bedrooms are conveniently located on one level. The private terrace offers stunning views, and the spacious backyard is perfect for relaxation or entertaining. Additional features include one-car parking with washer/dryer readiness and three-car parking on the driveway. Situated in a fantastic, convenient location close to UCSF, Metro, bus lines, shops, restaurants, and Golden Gate Park, this home on the coveted 8th Avenue block is a rare find! A must-see!
